Numerous green leaf patches with deep irregular rounded lobes along thin branches.
Two elevated flowering stem systems, each ending in a pair of dark blue cup-like forms with pale oval upper faces and narrow green surrounding shoots.
Root masses share crown/trunk continuity; painted leaves and thin outlines vary in completion.

fragment_anatomical_extent.observations: Intact stems and green blades rise from orange root; it is not visibly a root alone. Every connected botanical drawing in the complete nominated row has a leaf-bearing upper structure.
fragment_anatomical_extent.alternative_reading: If plant4 refers to the central long-rooted drawing, it is also leaf-bearing. If the nearer broad lobed leaf is the disputed owner, it is attached to the left tan root and has two inscriptions around that connected plant.

distinctive_concordance: Herbal and pharmacy botanical drawings have branching/rootlet structures and green leaf surfaces.
The left tan-root drawing has a broad irregular rounded-lobed leaf, making it the stronger foliar neighbor than the rightmost nominated orange drawing.
counter_features: Rightmost two blades have elongated fingers rather than f48v many small irregular rounded marginal lobes.
Rightmost orange root is a vertically lobed bulb/neck/lower mass with sparse curled rootlets, unlike f48v two spreading unpainted fibrous root masses.
Central pharmacy drawing has one large elongated broad blade and paired lateral orange swellings; neither repeats f48v numerous lobed leaves or paired cup-like flowers.
Left tan-root neighbor has one coarse rounded-lobed blade and a single enlarged elongated root, rather than f48v repeated fine-lobed foliage and two root fans.

No pharmacy drawing in row1 repeats the distinctive paired dark-cup/pale-face flowering clusters. Absence may be drawing simplification or stage/organ selection; it does not itself establish a cut operation.
